extension.summary: Files downloaded videos into Kodi's library as shows
extension.description: Takes the videos piling up in a download folder, works out which show each one belongs to, files it under that show with a season and episode number, and writes the NFO Kodi reads. Metadata comes from YouTube through yt-dlp when it is installed.[CR][CR]The console script this grew out of is still in the repository; this is the same work done from inside Kodi, on a schedule or on demand.
extension.news: v1.0.0[CR]First release as a Kodi add-on. The console script's work, done from inside Kodi: a service that watches the source folder on an interval, and a menu to run a pass, reset a show or clean up NFOs.
